messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme-analytics.com>, okrs@acme-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EOQ portfolio synthesis and next-playbook - OKR scoring notes

Team —

Attached is my draft synthesis of the end-of-quarter scoring across Platform + Product OKRs for Q1 (see attached QBR-evidence-pack.pdf). I focused this pass on:
- Outcome signal (customer-facing metrics and regressions)
- Evidence tie to launch artifacts and post-launch telemetry
- Residual risk areas that need rollforward plays

High-level asks:
1) Please review the judgement notes in section 2 of the PDF and flag any factual errors by COB Mon 15 Mar.
2) Add a 1–2 line justification if you disagree with a score (use the inline comments in the Drive link).
3) We need a short rollforward play for each objective tagged as At-Risk — add your recommended play to rollforward-playbook.md.

Key ambiguities I flagged: product latency SLO vs client-side timeouts (I called this mixed signal and recommended "partial credit"), and the Dedicated uplift attribution (sales vs infra).

I copied Acme to surface the one cross-customer impact item — Sarah, apologies for the CC; wanted you to see the timeline we propose.

Thanks — short, direct comments appreciated. I don't want long essays here; we will synthesize in the leadership pack.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR-evidence-pack.pdf (summary + annotated evidence), okr-heatmap.png (visual heatmap), rollforward-playbook.md (editable playbook stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: EOQ portfolio synthesis and next-playbook - OKR scoring notes

On Thu, Mar 11, 2027 at 9:12 AM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> Attached is my draft synthesis ...

Quick notes:
- Agree with the "partial credit" call on latency. The client-side timeout variance accounts for ~30% of observed failures — we should call that out in the leadership memo as a measurement limitation.
- For Dedicated uplift attribution: trade desk uplift should be split 70/30 infra:sales in our deck; will justify with the benchmark table I'm adding.

I'll add the 2-line justification for the objectives I own and drop a short rollforward for the at-risk infra objective into rollforward-playbook.md by EOD.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EOQ portfolio synthesis and next-playbook - OKR scoring notes

Irene / Vivek —

Thanks for the clear asks. I reviewed sections 2–4 and left inline comments in the Drive doc (link above). A few items to call out for the exec narrative:

- Narrative frame: start with what moved (metrics), then what we learned (evidence), and finish with the play (next 30/60/90). Keep it 3 slides.
- Evidence gaps: for the "Model stability" objective we only have two weeks of post-ship telemetry; I recommend marking that objective as "Provisionally Met" rather than Fully Met and adding a 30-day validation play.
- Customer impact: Sarah — the customer-facing incident in Feb is summarized on p.9 of the PDF; please confirm the remediation timeline so we can include a single bullet.

I've attached a short redline of the leadership paragraph that can slot into the pack (see attached rollforward-playbook.md — I appended three plays). Also included a compact heatmap export (okr-heatmap.png) for the slide.

If there are no disagreements by EOD today, I will merge the judgement notes into the leadership pack and prepare the slide deck skeleton.

Laura Bennett
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EOQ portfolio synthesis and next-playbook - OKR scoring notes

Quick confirmation from me —
- I updated rollforward-playbook.md with two engineering-led mitigations (one short-term canary and one 60-day refactor).
- For scoring, I changed Model Stability to "Provisionally Met" with the 30-day validation play noted.
- No objections to the Dedicated attribution split (Vivek's 70/30).

Thanks for running this. Once Laura merges the judgement notes into the leadership pack, I'm happy to run the 10-minute dry run for the QBR deck on Tue morning.

Aditya Rao
Senior Director, Product Engineering
Redwood Inference
